title: chelidonium majus var. laciniatum
intro: Chelidonium majus var. laciniatum, commonly known as the cut-leaved celandine, is a plant species in the poppy family that has been used in traditional medicine for its therapeutic properties. The plant is known for its health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Chelidonium majus var. laciniatum include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating various conditions such as urinary tract infections and skin issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, including berberine, which is responsible for its therapeutic effects.
